profile.headline: Software Developer at DIRECTV
profile.geoLocationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
profile.summary:
Miguel is an engineer with a diverse background and proven success in Software Development and Software Testing; he has worked on major and sustaining projects always delivering reliable high-quality products.  Possesses exceptional problem solving skills which have been further enforced with a minor in Applied Mathematics.  Has demonstrated ability to work well with and without supervision, as well as the ability to work solo and in teams.

Detail-oriented by nature, Miguel is very meticulous and sees every project through.  He has hands-on experience in the full development cycle from prototype through sustaining.  Highly motivated, hard working, proactive, honest, and very passionate about software.  Fluent in oral and written Spanish.

Contact Email: m_alvare5@yahoo.com

Specialties: Skilled in C/C++, PHP, HTML, CSS, VB.NET, JavaScript, Adobe Photoshop, MS Visio MS Office.  Familiar with Java, C#, Assembly Language 80x86, SQL, Python.  Hands-on experience with Windows 2000/2003/XP/2008, Linux, and SUN Solaris.  TOOLS: Ethereal, IBM ClearDDTS, Bugzilla, IBM Lotus Notes, Xyratex Analyzer, SCSIMaster, DELL DFU, IBM TDX, HP StorageWorks, TapeBench, FibreCalc, ApTest.

positions.title: Software QA III - Software Verification Testing (SVT)
positions.description: Quantum is a global leader in backup, recovery and archive technologies.  Joined the SVT team in 2007 working with disk-based backup libraries where I executed software, performance, and compatibility testing of new and existing products.  Activities ranged from analyzing and understanding documentation, and drafting test cases to hands-on testing utilizing a range of tools such as fibre analyzer, ethernet analyzer, and third-party software.

positions.title: Software QA II - Design Verification Testing (DVT)
positions.description: As a member of the DVT team at Quantum I led 5 major projects and 9 sustaining project with limited resources, often times concurrently, to successful and timely completion.  These projects include the PX720, PX500/Scalar 50, and SuperLoader3, with HP LTO, IBM LTO, Certance LTO, and DTL drive support.  Provided hardware and software testing of web-based robotic tape libraries, and improved testing by creating automated scripts using Python.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Provided technical expertise at CBC Spot, a start-up online video-game retailer.  Handled the planning, design, and development of the company web store from the ground up utilizing the Apache Server, PHP, HTML, JavaScript, and MySQL database.
